step1_analysis.description: A set of four independent NMOS transistors with grounded sources. Given the context of a Bluetooth receiver with a PGA and active filters, these are likely used as common-source amplifier stages, current steering switches, or part of a programmable gain amplifier (PGA) array.

paper_reference.title: 0.18-m CMOS Bluetooth Analog Receiver With 88-dBm Sensitivity

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the common-source configuration (with added 2kOhm load).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters with a 0.9V DC bias and a 2kOhm load resistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_parasitic). Assuming C_parasitic ~ 20fF and R_load = 2kOhm, f_3dB ~ 4 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant of the load resistor and the transistor's drain parasitic capacitance.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the four transistor stages.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the bias current of the four identical NMOS transistors operating in saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, bandwidth, and transient response of the NMOS array configured as common-source amplifiers with 2kOhm loads.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NMOS Array Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTY N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTX N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Input Signals (DC bias = 0.9V, AC = 1V for Bode plot, Tran = 10mV amplitude)
VINX N6 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 1MEG 0 0)
VINY N7 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 1MEG 0 0)
VIN8 N8 0 DC 0.9
VIN2 N2 0 DC 0.9

* Load Resistors to make the circuit functional as amplifiers
R1 OUTX VDD 2k
R2 OUTY VDD 2k
R3 N1 VDD 2k
R4 N0 VDD 2k

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let total_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print total_power
print v(OUTX) v(OUTY)

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(OUTX)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10k
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(midband_gain-3) fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_max max v(OUTX)
meas tran vout_min min v(OUTX)
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_pp

quit
.endc
.end
